rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has start date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The start date of something, such as a project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is fee or free
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The specification whether participation in an event is free, or requires payment of a fee.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides fraction of total funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between funding and a budget, specifying what fraction of the total budget is provided by that source of funding.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has ORCID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An individual's Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID), an alphanumeric identifier for individual scholars.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has application deadline
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date by which an application, for example a job application, a fellowship application or a grant application, has to be submitted if it is to be considered for acceptance or funding.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has birthday
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date of birth of an agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: organizational role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to an organization and its administration, particularly within an academic context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has temporal duration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The temporal duration of some entity such as an event or a project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scholarship
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A financial grant to a scholar to enable them to undertake advanced academic study.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has keyword
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A keyword relating to an entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: studentship
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A financial grant to a student to enable them to undertake advanced academic study.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: consultancy costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the costs of consultancy fees.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has currency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The currency used to specify a financial entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has registration deadline
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date by which registration must be made, for example renewal of an internet domain name.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directly allocated costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover those costs normally borne by an institution, that are assigned to the budget of an externally funded project to cover the value of contributions to that project, for example to pay for the salary of a permanent member of staff seconded to work on the project, to compensate the employing organization for the loss of that person's efforts on other activities that he or she would otherwise be undertaking were it not for that secondment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has data of manufacture
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date of manufacture of something.

rdf:Description.dc:creator: David Shotton (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5506-523X)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Funding, Research Administration and Projects Ontology (FRAPO)
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: David Shotton. The Funding, Research Administration and Projects Ontology. Revision: 1.2.0. http://purl.org/spar/frapo.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endeavour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An activity, such as a research investigation, that is enabled by a project.
rdf:Description.skos:note: An endeavour relates to the academic and practical aspects of undertaking that endeavour - thus for a research investigation the research itself, including the hypotheses being investigated, the experiments being undertaken, the data being gathered and analysed, the interpretations being drawn from the data, and the results obtained. In contrast, the project relates to the administrative aspects of undertaking an endeavour, including the funding obtained, the people employed, and the management of the project in terms of deadlines and deliverables.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding agency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization that provides funding for projects or resources, often in the form of grants awarded on the basis of competitive application.
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-funding-agency a frapo:FundingAgency ; foaf:name "The National Science Foundation" .

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the costs of services used by a project, for example a DNA sequencing service, or an equipment maintenance service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is employed by
rdf:Description.skos:note: This property should not be used for the other meaning of "employ", meaning to use something, e.g. "Great skill is employed by master craftsmen . . ."/
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an employed agent, typically a person or an organization, and an employing agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplies
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a supplier and a supplied entity, or an agent to whom the entity is supplied.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has time zone
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The time zone relating to an entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: consortium agreement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A formal agreement between members of a consortium, for example between research groups at different universities engaged in a multi-partner research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: account
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A mechanism for administering money, typically owned by an agent and dedicated to a particular purpose, for example the equipment account of a university department, to be used only for the purchase or maintenance of items of equipment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has organizational information
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Some information about the organization.
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-organization a foaf:Organization ; frapo:hasOrganizationalInformation "Non-profit research institute founded in 1980" .

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service contract
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contract for the provision of a service such as a cleaning service, or for the regular servicing, maintenance and repair of some item of equipment or infrastructure.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fee
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An amount of money paid for something that is not purchased.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is donated by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a gift and the benefactor who provided it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has catalog number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The catalog number of something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has domain name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An internet domain name that has been registered for an entity, for example http://www.miidi.org for MIIDI, the Minimal Information standard for reporting an Infectious Disease Investigation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has job title
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The job title held by a person, such as might appear next to the name in a directory or on a conference name badge. For example, the person's specific job title might be "Linacre Professor of Zoology" or "Regius Professor of Moral Philosophy".
rdf:Description.skos:note: This job title properly refers to the **role** held by that person (e.g. "Head of Department"), which can be separately defined using SCoRO, the Scholarly Contributions and Roles Ontology (http://purl.org/spar/scoro/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has end date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The end date for something, such as a project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: facilities costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the costs of maintaining facilities used by a project, for example an electron microscopy facility.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has name suffix
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The letters that should be displayed after a person's name.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has funder identifer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has post-nominals
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The letters that should be displayed after a person's name to indicate qualification, membership or fellowship in a professional society, honours or elite status, e.g. MRCVS, FRCS, FRS, OBE, Kt.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: status
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The status of something such as an application, an investigation or a project.
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-application pso:holdsStatusInTime :my-status-in-time .
:my-status-in-time a pso:StatusInTime ; pso:withStatus frapo:accepted .
frapo:accepted a frapo:Status .

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service contract fee
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A fee paid periodically, typically annually, to obtain access when required to a service such as an equipment maintenance contract."

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: computational service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A service provided by a computer system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: library
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A facility in which printed documents (for example books and journals) are deposited for long-term preservation and access.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: grant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A financial award by a funding agency for a particular project or purpose, usually awarded on the basis of a competitive application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: computational agent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A computer system or software program whose action has an effect on external events, for example a laboratory robot that undertakes your experiments, or the financial control system that controls an institution's payrole, or that, following programmed business rules, prevents the principal investigator from placing an order for research equipment because there is insufficient money left in the project budget.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has call identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifying number of a call for applications issued by a funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A unique and unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Recommended best practice is to identify the resource by means of a string conforming to a formal identification system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An administrative entity that enables an endeavour such as a research investigation. A project relates to the administrative aspects of undertaking an endeavour, including the funding obtained, the people employed, and the management of the project in terms of deadlines and deliverables. In contrast, an endeavour such as a research investigation relate to the academic and practical aspects of undertaking that endeavour - thus for a research investigation: the research itself, including the hypotheses being investigated, the experiments being undertaken, the data being gathered and analysed, the interpretations being drawn from the data, and the results obtained.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: submits
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent and an entity that is submitted to some third party, for example a grant application submitted to a funding agency, a manuscript submitted to a publisher, a quotation submitted by a vendor, or a dataset submitted by a researcher to a data repository.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endowment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A transfer, generally as a gift, of money or property to an institution to provide a permanent fund, the income from which is to be used for a particular purpose.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchase order
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An official order from a purchasing institution to a supplier for the purchase of goods or services, often issued in response to the receipt of a quotation from the supplier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An amount of money available to finance some project or activity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is supplied by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity that is supplied, or an agent to whom an entity is supplied, and the supplier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: accepted
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The status of something such as an application as having been accepted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has fax number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A fax number for an agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has post code
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The postal code of an address.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: department
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A department or sub-section within a larger organization, for example a university academic department.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: role in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A particular situation that describe a role an agent may have, that can be restricted to a particular time interval.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: holds role in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent and a role that the agent holds.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has expiry date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The expiry date of something, for example a drug, beyond which the manufacture recommends that it should not be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invoice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An invoice for payment of goods or services.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has decision date
rdf:Description.skos:note: This same data property appears in FaBiO, the FRBR-aligned Bibliographic Ontology (http://purl.org/spar/fabio/).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date on which a particular action is or will be decided upon, or when an application, such as a grant application, is or will be approved or rejected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has personal information
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Information about a person.
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-person a foaf:Person ; frapo:hasPersonalInformation "Senior Researcher at the Institute" .

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchases from
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a purchaser and a supplier from whom the purchase is made.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: owner
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The agent who owns an entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding application
rdf:Description.skos:note: For the documents supporting a funding application, use `fabio:GrantApplicationDocument` and `fabio:CaseForSupportDocument`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The activity of applying for funding.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: building costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the costs of constructing, renovating or modifying a physical building.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has provenance
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The description of the provenance of an entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tender
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Sealed bid or offer document submitted in response to a request for tenders, containing detailed information on costs, requirements and terms associated with a potential contract.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishing costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the cost of publishing outpots from a project, for example author fees for journal articles in an open access journal.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent that provides a service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has exchange rate
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: he currency exchange rate between two specified currencies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supports
rdf:Description.skos:note: This property is not intended for use to describe mechanical or physical support, as in "The plinth supports the statue".
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent and something that the agent supports by financial or other means.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is submitted by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity that is submitted (to some third party) and the agent who submits it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has quotation date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date of a quotation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has postal address line
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A single line of a postal address.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has currency code
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The three-letter currency code used to identify a currency, as defined by ISO 4217 (e.g. EUR or GBP).
rdf:Description.skos:note: Not to be confused with the symbol used with numbers to denote an amount of money in a particular currency (e.g.€500; £3.40).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: full economic costs
rdf:Description.skos:note: Frequently abbreviated "FEC".
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover all the direct and indirect costs of a project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: group
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A group of people.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchases
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a purchaser and a purchased entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has model number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The model number of something, for example a piece of equipment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specifies expenditure
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent or a budget and the expenditure specified by that agent or budget.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has award date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date on which notification is given or received that something, for example a scholarship or a grant, has been awarded. [See also frapo:hasDecisionDate.]

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: faculty
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A grouping of similar departments within a university context, also known as a school or a division, for example the Humanities Division, the Mathematics Faculty, or the School of Medicine.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is funding agency for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a funding agency and an entity for which it provides funding.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: investigation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An investigation is an endeavour that involves research, enabled by a project.
rdf:Description.skos:note: The investigation relate to the scholarly and practical aspects of conducting the research itself, including the hypotheses being investigated, the experiments being undertaken, the data being gathered and analysed, the interpretations being drawn from the data, and the results obtained. In contrast, the project that enables it encompasses the administrative aspects of undertaking the endeavour, including the funding obtained, the people employed, and the management of the project in terms of deadlines and deliverables.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: donates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a benefactor and a gift.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: non-staff costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover all the costs associated with a project that do not involve the employment of staff by the institution, thus, for example, including consumables purchase, travel costs and consultancy fees, but excluding the salary, estates and indirect costs associated with the allocation of the PI's time to the project and the direct employment of a project manager.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: consultancy agreement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contract between an employer and a consultant, detailing the terms of the consultancy.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has phone number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A telephone number for an agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: subscription
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Payment, commonly made annually, to obtain access to something on a periodic or continuing basis, such as a journal.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directly incurred costs
rdf:Description.skos:note: Also known as the "direct costs" of the project.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover all costs directly incurred because of a legitimate expenditure on a project, for example the purchase of reagents or the employment of a post-doctoral researcher.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has postal address
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A postal address for an agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: was purchased by
rdf:Description.skos:note: Domain constraints have been removed from this object property to permit it to be used in unforeseen ways.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a purchased entity and its purchaser.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaser
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent who purchases something from a supplier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has invoice date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date of an invoice.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent's role in time to a definition of the type of role held by this agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: budgeted amount
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The amount of money originally available to spend in a particular budget category.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has alternate name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An alternative name that a person uses for professional purposes, for example the pen name of an author, or a married woman's maiden name used as her professional name.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is funded by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between something and the funding that funds it (i.e. that finances or pays for it), or to the funding agency providing that funding. This flexibility is given because of alternative usages of the English word "funds".

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the costs of software licenses required by a project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: equipment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An item of equipment or apparatus, or a laboratory instrument, for example a refrigerated centrifuge.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: small to medium enterprise
sme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A small to medium enterprise, having up to 250 employees.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: enables
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and another entity that it enables, e.g. linking a project to an endeavour that the project enables.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has family name initial
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The initial(s) of a person's family name.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: person
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: output
rdf:Description.skos:note: Ontology terms and definitions for most publishable project outputs are given as "Expression" classes in FaBiO, the FRBR-aligned Bibliographic Ontology, e.g. `fabio:JournalArticle`, `fabio:DataSet`. For "deliverables", use `frapo:Deliverable`. For material outputs, use `frapo:MaterialOutput`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Something that is created or produced as a result of a project or an endeavour. Examples include a building resulting from a building project, educated students graduating from an educational programme, and a journal article published as a result of a research project. Research outputs can also include reports, datasets, experimental protocols, workflows and mathematical models, and material outputs such as a cell line, a mouse mutant or a new form of microscope.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: budget information
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Information about an aspect of a budget.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has agent information
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Information about an agent.
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-person a foaf:Person ; frapo:hasAgentInformation "Authorized representative for project negotiations" .

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evaluates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent and an entity which that agent evaluates, for example a funding agency that is evaluating a grant application to determine whether the proposed project is worthy of funding, or a publisher evaluating a manuscript to determine whether it is suitable for publication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has dispatch date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date on which something, for example an item of equipment, is dispatched by the supplier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: postal address
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A postal address.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: financial entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An entity primarily to do with money.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: collaborates with
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between agents, for example different organizations, or people typically from different groups or organizations, that work together on a common task, project or endeavour, or towards a common goal.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has familiar suffix
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The letters that may be displayed after a person's name to indicate familial status, e.g. Sn., Jn., III, 3rd.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rejected
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The status of something such as an application as having been rejected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: college
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An academic organization that is either a small degree-giving university, or (in the OxBridge sense) an independent corporation of scholars within a larger university, providing undergraduate tuition and a social environment for its students and fellows.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: agent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent (eg. person, group, software or physical artifact).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has deliverable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A deliverable of a project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deliverable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A class defining a "deliverable" of a project, i.e. something that the project set out to deliver, or succeeds in delivering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is awarded by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between something awarded and the agent making the award, for example linking a grant to a funding agency, a degree to a university, or a prize to the awarding organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: document repository
rdf:Description.skos:note: May also be described as a document archive, or a digital library.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A facility in which digital documents are deposited for long-term preservation and (optional) publication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration authority
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent with responsibility for registering and maintaining international standards, internet domain names, patents, controlled vocabularies and other similar entities required for reliable international cooperatative activities. For example, the International DOI Foundation (IDF) is the Registration Authority for DOIs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is enabled by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and another entity that enables it, e.g. linking an investigation to a project that enables it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: consumables costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the costs of purchasing consumables.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has personal identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A unique and unambiguous identifier for an individual person within a given context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has ORCID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between an individual and their Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID), an alphanumeric identifier for individual scholars.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has headcount
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The number of people employed by an organization.

rdf:Description.skos:note: Ontology terms and definitions for many documents relevant to FRAPO are given as "Expression" classes in FaBiO, the FRBR-aligned Bibliographic Ontology, e.g. `fabio:CallForApplications`, `fabio:DataManagementPlan`, `fabio:GrantApplicationDocument`, `fabio:ProjectPlan`. Others are given as sub-classes of this class.
rdf:Description.rdfs:label: document
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A document.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funded
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The status of something such as an investigation or a project as being funded.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: host institution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An institution that acts as a host, for example of a project, a resource or a person, for example by providing accommodation, services, operational support and/or funding.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: overhead costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover all the non-directly incurred costs of a project, including estates costs and indirect costs, that enable an institution to host an externally-funded project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: quotation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A formal statement of promise (usually provided in response to a request for quotation) by potential supplier to supply goods or services at specified prices and within a specified period. Acceptance of the quotation by the buyer constitutes an agreement binding on both parties.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: academic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a member of the academic staff of an academic institution, such as a university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: account statement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A statement of income and expenditure for an account, typically presented as dated income receipts and outgoings against categories in a budget for that account.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expenditure
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Money going out of an account, because of expenditure on various entities.
rdf:Description.skos:note: May be associated with a particular budget category.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: repository
rdf:Description.skos:note: May also be described as an archive, or as a database.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A facility in which entities can be deposited for long-term preservation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: uses facility
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an activity such as an expedition, a research project or an investigation, and a facility employed in that activity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding programme
rdf:Description.skos:note: Often associated with publication of a call for applications (`fabio:CallForApplications`).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A programme of related funded activities or projects, typically established by a funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: material output
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A material or physical output created or produced as a result of a project or an endeavour such as a research investigation. Examples include a building constructed as a result of a building project, and research outputs such as a cell line, a mouse mutant or a new form of microscope.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conference fee
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A fee paid to attend a conference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has project identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: research institute
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization primarily dedicated to undertaking research, that might be part of a university or of a commercial company, or might be independently funded by a research funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sells to
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a supplier and a purchaser to whom an entity is sold.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: owns IPR of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent who owns IPR arising from or relating and an entity to that entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: company
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A commercial company or business run for profit.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has supplier number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifying number for a supplier, typically used by the accounting system of the purchasing institution when placing and tracking orders.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is output of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between something that is created or produced and the activity that created or produced it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has curriculum vitae
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a person and an on-line version of that person's curriculum vitae.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: uses equipment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an activity such as an expedition, a research project or an investigation, and an item of equipment employed in that activity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has location
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relevant location for an entity, which might be geographical (e.g. New York City) or local (e.g. Freezer B, second shelf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchase
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The payment for obtaining something, for example property, goods or services.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has serial number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The serial number of something, for example a piece of equipment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has language code
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The two-letter or three-letter lower-case code used to identify a language (e.g. fr/fra for French, de/deu for Germany) (see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vendor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent who supplies goods or services in exchange for payment, in response to receipt of payment or of an official purchase order from a purchaser that is responded to by submission of an invoice for what is supplied.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has degrees
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The letters that should be displayed after a person's name to indicate an academic degree, e.g. BA, BVSc, PhD, DSc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fellowship
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The stipend paid to a fellow in a college or university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: awards
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent and something the agent awards, for example linking a funding agency to a grant, a university to a degree, or an organization to a prize.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has cost
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The cost of something that can be paid for to be defined.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: owns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent and an entity owned by that agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: status
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A state or condition that a document may have.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is supported by
rdf:Description.skos:note: This property is not intended for use to describe mechanical or physical support, as in "The statue is supported by the plinth".
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between something and an agent that provides funding or other support for it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has milestone
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A significant event (a "milestone") in the progress of a project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: infrastructure entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An entity that facilitates work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: budget category
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A category of expenditure within a budget, determining what the allocated money can be spent on, for example salaries, equipment, travel.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: status in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A particular situation that describe a state or condition some documents may have at a particular time as consequence of one or more events.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is evaluated by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and an agent that evaluates it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has account number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifying number for a financial account.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: university
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A university at which higher education and research is conducted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role an agent may have. Individual members of this class or its sub-classes are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is budget information of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between some budget information and the budget described by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: employment application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The activity of applying for a job.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has delivery date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date on which something is delivered, or is due to be delivered.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: legacy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A gift of money or property specified in the will of a person, that is made after that person's death.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: benefactor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who gives a gift.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: income
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Money coming into an account.
rdf:Description.skos:note: May be associated with a particular budget category.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has purchase date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The purchase date of something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: facility
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A place or installation built or designed to serve a specific function or provide a specific service, for example an animal breeding centre, a DNA sequencing facility or a confocal imaging laboratory.
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-facility a frapo:Facility ; foaf:name "Quipu DNA Sequencing Facility"@en .

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data repository
rdf:Description.skos:note: May also be described as a data archive, or as a database.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A facility in which digital data are deposited for long-term preservation and (optional) publication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent who supplies something, such as goods or services.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: business angel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person willing to invest in start-up companies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: applies for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent and something for which that agent applies, for example a job, membership of an organization, or a grant from a funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The activity of making an application, for example for a job, or for funding.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funds
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a grant and something that it funds (i.e. that it finances or pays for), or that links an agent providing funding to something that it funds. This flexibility is given because of alternative usages of the English word "funds". [See also frapo:awards and frapo:supports.]

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A service of help to others, often requiring funding, employees, equipment and/or facilities for its provision, for example a library service, a transportation service, a DNA sequencing service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: laboratory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A facility in which research can be conducted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has output
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an activity such as a project or endeavour and something that is created or produced as a result of that activity. Examples include a building created as a result of a building project, and a journal article published to describe the results of a research investigation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has code
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A code for something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The monetary value of a financial entity such as a grant, a gift or a budget category.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Use in conjuction with `frapo:hasCurrency`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has creation date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date of creation of a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manufactures
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a manufacturer and a manufactured entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has completion date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date of completion for something, such as a building or a contract.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has qualification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The qualification held by a person.
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-person frapo:hasQualification "Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science" .

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: article processing charge
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A fee levied by a publisher on an author or an institution to cover the cost of publishing an Open Access journal article. Also knows as Article Processing Fee, Article Publication Charge, Author Processing Charge or Author Publishing Charge.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project budget
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget for a research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has batch number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The manufacturing batch number for something, for example a chemical or drug.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contract
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A legally binding agreement between parties.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has country code
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: AThe two-letter or three-letter upper-case country code used to identify a country (e.g. FR/FRA for France, DE/DEU for Germany).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manufacturer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent who manufactures goods or equipment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: given name initial
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The initial(s) of a person's given name(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: employment contract
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contract of employment between a person and an organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has birth date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The birth date of a person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has customer number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifying number for an agent, typically used by the accounting system of the supplier when issuing quotations, fulfilling orders and submitting invoices.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has budget category
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between some budget information and its category.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has budget information
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a budget and some piece of information describing it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: travel and subsistence costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the costs of travel and subsistence incurred on behalf of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is manufactured by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a manufactured entity and its manufacturer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: financial control system
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A software system controlling the financial activities of an organization, for example determining full economic cost budgets for grant applications, and managing the funding of funded projects.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has expertise
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The area(s) of expertise and skills posessed by an individual or an organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has purchase order number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An official purchase order issued by a purchasing agent to a supplier of goods or services, and used by the supplier to identify the order when delivering goods or submitting an invoice.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has budget
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A structured statement of how funds are to be used for expenditure in defined budget categories. A budget is created, for example, when applying for funding for a project, and is subsequently used to manage the expenditure from the awarded grant for that project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: stipend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A sum of money allotted on a regular basis, usually for some specific purpose.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is owned by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and the agent that owns it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: division
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A grouping of similar departments within a larger organization. In the university context, also known as a school or a faculty, for example the Humanities Division, the Mathematics Faculty, or the School of Medicine.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: estates costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the "overhead" costs of maintaining the premises in which work is undertaken.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: investment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An investment of money, generally in stocks and shares, or in property, for the purpose of safeguarding the capital and yielding an income.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has reference number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The reference number for something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has acronym
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An acronym used to identify an entity, based on its full name or title. For example, this ontology has the full name "Funding, Research Administration and Projects Ontology" and the acronym "FRAPO".

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: holds status in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a document, a dataset or some other thing and a status that it holds at a specific time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration agency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An institution or organization officially appointed by a Registration Authority that acts to register things. For example, CrossRef is a registration agency for DOIs relating to documents, while DataCite is a registration agency for DOIs relating to datasets, acting for the Registration Authority for DOIs, namely the International DOI Foundation (IDF).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: payment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A financial payment made, for example in exchange for something purchased such as property, goods or services, or to refund expenses incurred.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with status
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the holding of a status to a document, a dataset or something else at a specific time and the definition of that status.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has personal identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A unique and unambiguous identifier for an individual person within a given context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has city or town
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The specification of a city or town, for example as the location of an event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: research group
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A group of people, usually within a university department or a research institute, and typically under a single group leader, dedicated to working together to undertake research on one or more topics. May also be called a research unit.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bursary
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An amount of money given to a person by an organization, for example by a university to a university student in need to enable that student to continue his/her studies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has IPR owner
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity such as a project, an endeavour or an output and an agent who owns the IPR arising from or related to that entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scholarship application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The activity of applying for an educational scholarship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover costs not covered in other budget categories.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: commitments
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Money set aside to honour expenditures already made but for which no invoices have yet been received, or expenditures planned for the future, for example for salaries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: not-for-profit organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization that does not primarily exist to make profit, for example a charity or charitable foundation, a learned society, or a standards body such as the World Wide Web Consortium.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has funding agency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between something and a funding agency that provides funding for it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has country
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A country, for example as the location of an event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: indirect costs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to cover the indirect costs of running a project, for example heating and lighting, and the employment of non-project staff including administrators, accountants and cleaners.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has application outcome
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The description of an outcome of an application, for example that a job has been offered or that a grant has been awarded.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: employs
rdf:Description.skos:note: This property should not be used for the other meaning of "employ", meaning to use something, e.g. "He employed great skill . . ."/
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an employing agent and an employed agent, for example a person or an organization, who is typically employed to undertaking specified work in exchange for payment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has initials
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The initial(s) of a person's name.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gift
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A gift, donation, benefaction or legacy, typically of money.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: uses service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an activity such as an expedition, a research project or an investigation, and a service employed in that activity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: admission application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The activity of applying for admission to some group or institution, for example a learned society or a university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: unfunded
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The status of something such as an investigation or a project as being unfunded.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: annual turnover
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The annual financial turnover of an organization (in a specified currency).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has grant number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The grant number of a grant provided by a funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: financial role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to academic and project finance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expenditure to date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Total money expended to date from an an account, or from a particular budget category.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contributions in kind
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A budget category to categorize the financial worth of contributions in kind (e.g. staff effort, access to facilities, sharing of know-how) given to a project by an agent, for example by the host institution or by a commerical partner in an academic project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: available funds
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The amount available to spend in a budget category, equalling the income minus the expenditure to date plus future expenditure commitments.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: government organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization that is part of, or funded by, central or local goverment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: spin-off company
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A company that has been established by a university or research institute to mature and market the results of research conducted at that research institution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: research information system
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A database containing administrative information about the research undertaken in an institution, and the publications and other outputs from such research.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: entrepreneur
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who invests in novel enterprises.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is applied for by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between something applied for and the agent making the application.
